Results.ReviewText:
At present I can only rate this grill based upon it's looks, features, design and build quality.

I bought this to replace a 20 year old Weber Genesis Silver A grill which was worn out and ugly even though the old boy was still cooking (the original ignitor was still working !) .

This grill is so nice and clean and pretty that I have not had the heart to begin getting it all
nasty dirty and grill funky from cooking on it. 

Meanwhile I have a 1970ish Weber Imperial Sequoia 22 1/2 " BBQ wagon that I will continue using until I figure out what to cook on the new grill for the first time break in.

There is no doubt in my mind that this is the best gas grill ever made by Weber or any other 'Common Man's'  LP gas grill out there which is available for purchase in big box stores.

At first I had buyers remorse because I was sad to let go of my old Silver A Genesis because of all the good meals made on it and I could have kept it going for a couple of
more years (that is how good Weber made it) I have no regrets now. I did cannibalize
the Silver A for parts before donating the remainder to the Boy Scouts metal recycle bin.
Results.Title: Can't Get Much Better Than This

Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
The good - and a lot of it: well placed, quality temp gauge & Weber name plate, very good quality high-temp enamel paint on top and properly painted in the factory for excellent adhesion, cast iron grates: excellent dual profile design and porcelain coating quality , reliable and easily serviceable electronic ignition that so far has lighted first time every time, excellent gas valve portioning, excellent quality stainless steel burner tubes and rear tracer lighting tube, wonderful carcass bottom angular design for guiding grease to well-placed, easy front access, adequate capacity grease pan, tank placement on right side makes easy tank access and frees inside for a nice shelf made of no rust, no rot plastic with slat surfaces that looks attractive. I can't report the durability of the plastic wheels and stationary leg feet. Check other long-term reviews to see if they don't split like other brand grill wheels & feet.

The Improvable: grates lack a front finger hole to lift grate for brushing grate bottoms, stick-on badge next to right burner knob and Spirit name plate both applied crooked that makes grill look cheap, propane tank holder fits most, but not all tanks. Reported reliability of the i-Grill 3 needs to improve before I buy one.

Tips: regardless of what Weber says about no-stick techniques I've found the best practice that works every time for me is to use the Weber no-stick spray lube: preheat grill at the heat setting to be used for that food item: Example: burgers: preheat, medium heat to 450°, get everything ready for quick access, lift top, spray a little squirt right where one burger is going and put it immediately on, squirt next, quickly put next burger on, repeat, repeat, repeat, close top as quickly as possible not to lose too much heat. Then stainless steel brush the tops of grates right after taking off food - let cool, lift grates and brush the bottoms to dislodge hanging pieces. If there is a big crusty blob of burnt grease on a flavorizer bar I knock it mostly off with the brush then, but I don't scrape the rest unnecessarily. Voila, ready for next grilling with a nice, clean shiny, pre-seasoned grate. 

I hope that helps. This Weber heats pretty darn evenly front to back and side to side for me - unlike my last two grills, making it much easier to get a batch of burgers or steaks at the same doneness. I use Bluetooth meat thermometers always- but not the Weber brand until reviews of reliability improve. This and the crooked badges are the 5th star deletion. If I could have given 4 1/2 stars I would have, because everything else is excellent!

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for letting us know about the issue you are having. We are so sorry to learn that your grill is not getting hot enough. Your grill should easily reach 500F. 

It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset but how you want to light your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position (including side burner if applicable)
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 30-60 seconds
Turn the first burner to start/high
Hit your igniter
Turn on all remaining burners

This should help solve your issue! Our support team sent an email to make sure that your grill is working properly. Thank you for your feedback and for being a Weber fan.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills
